newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's copper, gold output climbed in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Peru's copper, gold output climbed in 1996.

text.p: Peru's copper output rose by 18.1 percent in 1996 to 483,880 tonnes from 409,693 tonnes in 1995, the Energy and Mines Ministry said Thursday.
Copper production rose in December by 8.31 percent to 39,916 tonnes from 36,852 tonnes in the same month in 1995.
Peru is the world's sixth largest copper producer. Its largest producer, Southern Peru Copper Corp, accounts for around 60 percent of the country's output.
Peru's gold production in 1996 rose 12.2 percent to 64.8 tonnes from 57.7 tonnes. Output in December climbed 2.6 percent to 5.3 tonnes from 5.2 tonnes in December 1995.
Silver output in the year rose 3.1 percent to 1,968 tonnes from 1,909 tonnes. December production slipped 0.5 percent to 169 tonnes from 170 tonnes.
The ministry added that Peru's zinc output rose 9.6 percent to 758,431 tonnes in 1996 from 692,290 tonnes in 1995. Zinc output in December gained 7.9 percent to 62,398 tonnes from 57,806 tonnes.
Production of lead last year rose 4.6 percent to 248,477 tonnes from 237,597 tonnes, while output in December grew 2.5 percent to 20,481 tonnes from 19,988 tonnes.
